steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Urgh, god dammit, where in the world did my card key go...

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Did I flush it while taking a dump?

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Chief Barton, what's wrong?

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Mind your own business!

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Y-Yes, sir!

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Tsk, stuck-up asshole...

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: I'm guessing... someone probably pissed him off.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Heh, probably Anthony.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: I don't really know what's going on, but it seems like someone's trying to kill him.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Barton likes to brag about how perfect the prison is. This is gonna keep him on tenterhooks.

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: We're prison guards, you know.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Eh, it's not someone getting killed that I'm happy about. I just like seeing him so peeved.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Besides, let's be honest. We've seen Randal and Barton do so much dirty work over the years.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: If you ask me, I think Randal knows who sent these hitmen in here. He's just turning a blind eye because he's in their pocket.

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Don't move, Robin.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Don't make me kill you.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Well, damn, Robin. You're good. Even I didn't have you pegged for a spy.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I think you just might have a gift for this gig.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Wait a minute. What are you holding?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Whoa, that a bomb switch?!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Kafka, lower the tower right now!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Whoa! It's burning!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Hurry!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I forgot which one's which!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: And I kinda get the feeling these probably aren't gonna work anymore!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Oh, there we go! Should be this one!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Please! Please work!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: There!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: It's not moving! Is the thing broken?!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Robin, why are you doing this?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: It's going down!

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Dagnabbit!

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Whatever, I don't even remember when was the last time I was up there.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Just need to have Randal make me a new one.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Tsk.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Chief Barton, you...

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: I'm heading upstairs to see how those damned fools are doing with the clean-up work!

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: What... What happened here?!

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: What in the name of... What's going on here?!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Hold onto something, Kafka!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Anthony, over there! Robin's gonna get thrown into the elevator!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Hold on tight, Robin!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Why...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Save it for later!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Get ready!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Anthony, you and Robin okay?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'm fine. I got Robin.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Seems like the whole prison's power went out. It's pitch dark here.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: This is an opportunity for us.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: It feels like the tower crashed straight through the floor.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: We're probably at the second floor basement. Still some distance away from the clinic.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Right, we should get going before the jailers get here.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Robin, are you okay?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I-Is it really a good thing that I'm okay?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: It is.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Don't let it get to you.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I did tell you before you could keep trying to kill me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: If you think you betrayed me for what you did, let me tell you this—

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'm afraid none of us are close enough to talk about trust just yet.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Heh, not even me?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Not even you.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Oh, come on, that's cold.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Wouldn't you say it's more problematic to completely trust a person after just a few months?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Of course, I am a little disappointed, but that's all.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Nonetheless, I'm curious. I can tell you weren't acting when we were working together. You can't fake those emotions.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Why did you do this, Robin?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: My father. He made lots of money, and he was nice to me. I'm proud of him.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But one day, his company went bankrupt.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: And he's been a failure ever since.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: So he changed. He started drinking a lot, and he got angry. He hated everything around him.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: My mother left him. He was heavily in debt, and in the end, went into the hospital with liver problems, and so many other complications I don't even get the details of.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: My mother tried to talk me into moving in with her.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But I never forgot how well my father used to treat me.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I wanted to do something for him. So I gave up my hobbies. I tried taking on all kinds of jobs, but the medical bills kept coming.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Then, one day, someone came to me. He said he could give me lots of money. I just had to kill someone for him.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: And I'm the target.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I see. I can't offer you anything, and that's why you made this choice.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: No, he's been watching you here, dressed as a jailer. His name is Jesselton.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: After you made me the offer, he found me and told me—

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: The very last thing that the Simons did was destroy my father's company.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: My goodness.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: In that case, not only should I not hold this against you, I must apologize.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: No, don't apologize. That isn't what I'm trying to say.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: It's not like that, Anthony.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I knew I was doin' wrong. I knew I shouldn't do it.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But I gave up.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I didn't know what I was supposed to do, otherwise. I just didn't know.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'm tired. My mother wanted me to make a choice, my father wanted me to make a choice, life wanted me to make a choice, Jesselton wanted me to make a choice, and even you wanted me to make a choice.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I don't wanna make any choices. I don't wanna judge what's right or what's wrong, good or bad. I just don't want to.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'm sick of it! Why do I have to choose?!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: But, you know, Robin, you can't just hand off your decisions.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You have to think everything through and make your own choices. Then, you need to take responsibility for each of those choices.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Otherwise, you'll never be able to take your fate into your own hands.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: This is the most important thing I've learned during my years here in prison.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Strength is important, and so is intelligence, but the most important trait of all is courage. The courage to make your own decisions and pay the price for them.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'm afraid of making wrong decisions myself, but I can't let that get in the way of making decisions at all.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I used to think I had no one to rely on because I hadn't found anyone reliable, but I've come to realize there is no one we can truly rely on anywhere in this world.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No one but ourselves.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'm sorry I didn't notice your pain in time, Robin.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I must reiterate. What you've done almost ruined my escape plan. That's why I won't forgive you so easily.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Nonetheless, as someone who has suffered a similar situation, I hope you can forget about all this for the time being.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You must scrutinize yourself and think about what it is that you want to do.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: What it is... that I want to do...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Domma's room is right up ahead. You have all the time you need to think.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I understand if you don't completely trust me, but I told Jesselton everything about your plan. He's definitely waiting for you somewhere up ahead.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I know.
Oh, you don't hafta worry about finding me. I've been waiting for you right here.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: It's coming from Domma's room!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You don't mean...?!
